accepted_by: Relic implementation review under the owner-authorized processing scope
geometry_policy: Unchanged publisher GeoJSON Point, explicitly city_level_approximate. It is a city reference point, never the observed incident site or a surveyed coordinate.
occurrence_policy: A uniquely matching exact publisher name or explicitly reviewed alias may supply a city-level location hypothesis only for event role under the caller reported-event gate. Canonical-name-only guesses, conflicting country constraints, ambiguity, origin/destination/issuer/mentioned roles and non-reported-event material cannot produce occurrence geometry.
country_policy: Use each city record ISO_A2 and ADM0NAME directly. These are dated publisher classifications; do not infer legal recognition or crosswalk sovereignty/country layers.
names_policy: Retain NAME, NAMEASCII, NAMEALT and explicit NAME_<language> publisher values. Case/whitespace normalization only; no fuzzy names, nearest-coordinate guessing or unrestricted transliteration.

quality.validation: All original features have a unique integer NE_ID, a name, and a finite two-dimensional WGS84 point. Checks establish format and provenance, not accuracy or completeness.

limits: Source release is from 2022; individual location observation dates are not supplied.
243 selected publisher cities worldwide are not a complete city gazetteer.
Haifa, Gaza, Isfahan, Aleppo, Basra and Mosul are absent; preserve unresolved outputs.

Country and territory publisher names are accepted only as broad identity/context candidates under the explicit country_identity policy here; no country occurrence coordinates or analytical boundaries are accepted.
No inherited input, facility annotation, population estimate or AI-provided coordinate is accepted by this policy.

refresh.policy: A new source release or alias change requires a distinct reviewed acceptance and hash; retain the old reference for prior interpretations.

country_identity.purpose: Exact publisher country/territory names may identify broad contextual candidates during message reading. This is a separate processing acceptance, not an extension inferred from navigation permission.
country_identity.geometry_policy: Do not read or return country label points, centroids or polygons as occurrence geometry. Never infer a city from a country mention.
country_identity.deduplication: Exact publisher NE_ID only; prefer admin_0_countries over matching tiny-country identity.
